The deal combines a new five-year commercial agreement with a $100 million equity investment from Binance.
• Circle Internet Group shares are consolidating.
Binance Expands USDC Partnership
Binance will expand the promotion and integration of USDC across its platform, while Circle will support the stablecoin through its Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure.
Circle will also pay Binance a monthly incentive fee tied to USDC held through the service.
The agreement replaces earlier arrangements from November 2024 and August 2025 and may be terminated early under specified circumstances.
Circle co-founder, Chairman and CEO
Jeremy Allaire
said the partnership could broaden USDC access across emerging markets.
Binance Takes $100 Million Circle Stake
Binance bought 1.237 million Circle Class A shares at $80.84 apiece through a private placement, representing a discount to the market price before closing.
The shares are generally subject to a two-year transfer restriction, with customary exceptions. Binance retains voting and other shareholder rights during that period.
Binance co-CEO
Richard Teng
said, “Our $100 million investment and five-year commitment represent long-duration conviction.”
Circle’s platform includes USDC, Circle Payments Network and its Arc blockchain.

CRCL Technical Outlook: Uptrend Holds, Momentum Cools
Circle remains above key moving averages, trading 2.9% above its 20-day SMA of $92.12 and 21.7% above its 50-day SMA of $77.91.
However, momentum has cooled. MACD remains below its signal line with a negative histogram, suggesting buying pressure has weakened from the previous upswing.
The 50-day SMA also remains below the 200-day SMA, keeping the longer-term technical setup mixed.
Resistance sits near $103.50, while support is around $86.00, close to the 200-day SMA of $86.01.
